OUR HERITAGE & FOUNDATION

Warehouse Racking Built Around Your Operation

ProRack Storage Solutions India Pvt. Ltd. is a warehouse engineering and storage solutions company within the ProRack AI Group. The business builds on the legacy of Silver Lining Storage Solutions, the warehouse storage business of Mangal Industries, part of the Amara Raja Group.

As we take ownership of this legacy, we are developing the business with a focus on accountability, transparency and AI integration across warehouse engineering and project delivery.

"We design every warehouse solution around the customer's operational requirements, storage profile, material-handling systems, available space, and future growth trajectory."

Our Core Operating Pillars

1
BIM Solution Engineering

Tekla Structures 3D modeling and RSTAB finite element analysis validate every connection before manufacturing.

2
Strict Codes & Tolerances

Compliance with EN 15512, RMI, and IS 800 standards, alongside planned IIT-Powai academic certification.

3
Complete Project Transparency

Structured change order management and tracked project status from coil slitting to site handover.

Leadership / ProRack AI

Practical experience.
Clear direction.

Engineering, manufacturing
and delivery. Together.

Managing Director Roshan Sudhir brings over 20 years of hands-on leadership across warehouse, manufacturing and heavy industrial infrastructure projects. Roshan leads ProRack's engineering team and coordinates the design and delivery of storage installations.

Under his leadership, ProRack AI has integrated engineering design, specialised site installation through SmartFit Solutions, and warehouse MEP infrastructure through ProMec Integration to coordinate the work across each project.

Our team / ProRack Storage Solutions

Meet the team.

Girish Annath

Director, ProRack Storage Solutions

Girish brings extensive experience in operations management, infrastructure development and business leadership. His career includes leadership roles at OEC Records Management, NAX (Navbharat Archive Xpress), Iron Mountain and Recall, where he contributed to facility development, operational standardisation and security practices.

His experience in business development, strategy and materials management gives him a practical understanding of infrastructure and business needs. At ProRack Storage Solutions, he heads the HR function and focuses on recruiting the people needed to grow the business.

Prajakta Roshan

Administration Head, ProRack AI

Prajakta Roshan plays an important role in ProRack AI, bringing a diligent, detail-oriented approach to the company’s administration and day-to-day operations. As a key stakeholder in the business, she is committed to ensuring that internal processes are organised, responsibilities are managed efficiently, and the organisation’s foundations remain strong as it grows.

Known for her meticulous nature and sense of responsibility, Prajakta contributes to building a disciplined, well-coordinated working environment that supports ProRack AI’s long-term vision.

Kshitij Salve

VP, Sales & Marketing

Kshitij has over 20 years of experience in branding, communication, sales, stakeholder management and building and leading teams.

He has worked across brands including Panasonic, Fiat, Skoda India, ICICI Prudential, SBI and Bajaj Hindustan, and has handled social media for leading Indian cricketers. At ProRack, he brings this experience to sales, marketing and the way the company communicates its work in the warehousing industry.
